languageParity: All frontend/public notices and labels must exist in HR and EN with identical substance.

hr: Workeri smiju pripremati, sažimati, spremati i objavljivati samo u dopuštenim javnim kategorijama.
Financijske, pravne, osobne i statusne tvrdnje idu u manual review.
Izvješća se spremaju u reporting queue i prikazuju operatoru.
Nema masovnog slanja, nema kampanja i nema javnog admin pristupa.
en: Workers may prepare, summarize, save and publish only in allowed public categories.
Financial, legal, personal-data and status claims go to manual review.
Reports are stored in the reporting queue and displayed to the operator.
No mass sending, no campaigns and no public admin access.

dailyCycles.hr: Srednji pregled: queue objava, status kontakata, ručni review i blokade.
dailyCycles.en: Midday review: publication queue, contact status, manual review and blocks.

dailyCycles.hr: Večernje izvješće: što je objavljeno, što čeka, što je blokirano i sljedeći koraci.
dailyCycles.en: Evening report: what was published, what is pending, what is blocked and next steps.
